verdict.rationale: Unleash ships a self-hostable Docker image, a full Admin/Client API, and scoped API tokens designed for automation/SDKs rather than human UI use, and a hands-on probe confirms a complete keyless headless workflow (docker boot, flag creation via Admin API, evaluation via Client API) with no manual UI steps — exactly the CI/automation pattern the story asks for. missing for 10: no independent third-party CI pipeline example or official CI/CD docs page walking through pipeline integration.
